ways.description: Buffer API key
ways.instructions: Make a key in Buffer at [Settings, API](https://publish.buffer.com/settings/api): open the **Personal Access** tab, select **+ New Key** under **Keys**, name the key, leave every permission ticked, choose when it expires and select **Generate API Key**. ways.description: GitHub fine-grained personal access token
ways.instructions: Make a token at [GitHub](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new), under **Settings**, **Developer settings**, **Personal access tokens**, **Fine-grained tokens**. As **Resource owner**, choose the account or organization that owns the repositories, and under **Repository access** select the repositories your functions use. Under **Permissions**, give **Contents** read-only access, and **Issues** and **Pull requests** read and write access. An organization that requires approval keeps the token pending, reading public resources alone, until an organization administrator approves it. The token starts with `github_pat_`.

ways.description: Slack bot token
ways.instructions: Find the token in your Slack app's settings at [api.slack.com/apps](https://api.slack.com/apps): choose the app, then **OAuth & Permissions**. Under **Bot Token Scopes**, add `channels:read`, `channels:history`, `users:read`, `chat:write`, `reactions:read` and `reactions:write`, and `groups:read` and `groups:history` for private channels. Select **Install to Workspace** and **Allow**, then copy the token under **OAuth Tokens**. It starts with `xoxb-`.
